digest.component_or_area: LLM fallback model instrumentation and tracing
propositions: Each attempted fallback candidate must emit exactly one rebar OTel span with zero-based order and provider-qualified model identity, nested as a child span under the single Agent model-request span via ambient OTel context, with no duplication from instrument_all.

Each candidate span must carry an outcome attribute from {returned, raised}, where returned indicates the model succeeded and raised indicates the candidate failed; the existing ordered FallbackExceptionGroup remains unchanged.
Candidate span failure reasons must be sanitized through sanitize_diagnostic and placed under the message key, containing no prompt, response, credentials, or endpoint secrets.

The S2-preserved bug-895c native-to-prompted downgrade must be legible as a native attempt span with raised outcome followed by a prompted attempt span with returned outcome, with no change to _pai_structured control flow.
Span emission or exporter failures while tracing is enabled must be swallowed at the wrapper boundary so that fallback result, RunUsage, and propagated exceptions are identical to tracing-off.
RunUsage, UsageLimits, pricing, durable JSONL, and FallbackModel selection must remain identical with tracing on and off, with no candidate counter added to usage tracking.
